_quarry.citation: Procopius of Caesarea. History of the Wars. Translated by H. B. Dewing. 7 vols. Loeb Classical Library. Cambridge, MA: Harvard University Press, 1914–1928.
_quarry.notes: Greek prose history (~553 CE) of Justinian's Persian, Vandal, and Gothic wars. The Dewing Loeb edition is the standard English-Greek parallel text; the more recent Kaldellis revisions (Hackett 2014, 2019) are the closer reader's translation. Pairs with the Secret History (Anecdota) and the Buildings (De Aedificiis) as the three works of Procopius.
